subject: Billing routing for multi-entity account & portal onboarding
messages:
From: Linda Park <linda.park@northshore.co>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>; Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <finance@northshore.co>
Date: 2025-10-08T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Billing routing & invoice origin for multi-entity setup

Hi Sofia / Connor,

Quick note from AP — we need to lock down how Redwood will issue invoices for our account. We are a multi-entity buyer (Northshore US / Northshore EU) and require:

- Per-entity invoice origin so each invoice shows the correct remit and VAT handling.
- Portal enrollment as preferred delivery, but would like emailed PDF copies during the first 2 billing cycles while the portal is being provisioned.
- VAT evidence attached to invoices for EU entity (VAT ID + certificate).
- PO mapping: each invoice must reference PO number and match line-level descriptions.

Attached is PO_7789.pdf as an example. Can you confirm: who will be the invoice creator (single origin per entity vs consolidated), what the timeline is for portal activation, and whether you can include VAT certificate on invoice PDF?

Also advise preferred payment instructions to include on the PDF (ACH vs wire). Our preference is ACH.

Thanks,
Linda Park
AP Manager, Northshore Systems
Attachments: PO_7789.pdf

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Linda Park <linda.park@northshore.co>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, AP Team <finance@northshore.co>
Date: 2025-10-08T11:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Billing routing & invoice origin for multi-entity setup

Hi Linda — thanks for the clear note and the PO sample. Short answers up-front, then propose next steps: 

- Invoice origin: we can emit per-entity invoices. For each legal entity we will designate a single invoice originator so remit and tax fields are correct. If you want a consolidated statement we can provide that separately but the invoices themselves should originate from the entity that supplies the services.
- Delivery: portal will be primary once enrolled. We will configure automatic PDF copies to finance@northshore.co for the first two billing cycles; after that we can switch to portal-only if you prefer.
- VAT evidence: we can attach VAT ID/certificate to the invoice PDF for EU entity. Please provide the certificate (or a trusted link) and the exact VAT ID to print on the invoice.
- PO mapping: we will include the PO number on the invoice header and echo line-level descriptions when available.
- Payment method: ACH is supported. I will include our banking instructions on the invoice header; for security we can provide a signed bank details PDF or send via secure portal link.

Next steps / timeline:
- Action: Northshore to confirm VAT certificate and VAT ID (Linda) — due 2025-10-10.
- Action: Redwood to share invoice template and sample populated PDF (attached) and a portal onboarding form (Sofia). Deliver by 2025-10-09.
- Action: Redwood finance (Marissa) to prepare ACH instructions and agreed remit text to insert into PDF.

I attached our invoice template (redwood_invoice_template_v1.pdf) and a short portal onboarding form. Once we have the VAT cert we can provision portal access and switch to portal-first delivery.

If it helps, Connor and I can do a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through the portal screens and show where the PO and VAT fields appear.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Customer Billing, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_invoice_template_v1.pdf; portal_onboarding_form.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Linda Park <linda.park@northshore.co>, AP Team <finance@northshore.co>
Date: 2025-10-09T08:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Billing routing & invoice origin for multi-entity setup

Thanks Sofia — looping in the implementation details on our side. A few clarifications and proposed owner list: 

- Invoice creator mapping: we will configure two invoice issuers: Redwood, Inc. (US entity) and Redwood Europe GmbH (EU entity). That will give Northshore per-entity remits and VAT handling.
- Portal behavior: during provisioning we will set up an "email copy" toggle: triggered for the first 2 cycles. After that we will default to portal-only unless you ask us to continue emailing PDFs.
- VAT evidence: AP will need the VAT certificate attached as a flattened PDF on the invoice; we will consume that into our archive and include the VAT number in the invoice header (no free-text).

Owners / deadlines:
- Linda: supply VAT certificate + confirm remit preferences (by 2025-10-10) — Linda.
- Marissa: finalize ACH instructions and produce signed bank details PDF (by 2025-10-09) — Marissa.
- Connor: schedule a 20-min walkthrough and confirm portal field mapping (by 2025-10-09) — Connor.

Note on PO line mapping: if PO line-level descriptions are missing we will include the PO number and a single-line description: "Redwood inference platform usage" and attach the detailed usage CSV to the invoice package for reconciliation. If you need line-level amounts to match across your AP system we can also enable an EDI-style CSV feed as a follow-up (this will need SFTP or API mapping).

Connor — can you propose two 20-minute slots tomorrow morning? I will prepare the signed bank PDF and attach it to the next message.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Linda Park <linda.park@northshore.co>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, AP Team <finance@northshore.co>
Date: 2025-10-10T14:20:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Billing routing & invoice origin for multi-entity setup

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the template — that helps. Confirming: we will provide the EU VAT certificate and VAT ID by EOD tomorrow.

A few follow-ups: 
- Please send the DocuSign link for the portal enrollment form so we can get our AP admin access provisioned this week.
- ACH is preferred; please send the signed banking details PDF to finance@northshore.co. We will whitelist the sender for the first two cycles.
- On the EDI-style CSV: we are not ready for SFTP yet, so emailed detailed usage CSV attached to invoice package is fine for now. If you can include the usage CSV as a machine-readable attachment that will speed our reconciliation.

If we can get portal access and the first two emailed PDFs this month, we can schedule the first payment run for 11/05.

Thanks — Linda
Linda Park
AP Manager, Northshore Systems
Attachments: (will upload VAT certificate once confirmed)
